articles.author: ZedIoT
articles.description:
The Problem


We worked with a large-scale manufacturer that manages hazardous gases across multiple production zones. Their legacy system had:
No real-time gas leak alerts
Manual-only worker incident tracking
No mobile visibility for safety teams
Difficulty scaling to new factory locations
They needed a customizable, mobile-first, and scalable solution.
We co-developed a custom gas detection system using edge + cloud components:
Fixed and portable sensors for CO, NO₂, CH₄ detection
Wearable tags with fall detection via motion sensing
Edge gateways pushing real-time MQTT events
Mobile dashboard + alert routing
Auto-escalation logic for critical events (voice alerts, sirens)
Weekly compliance reports via cloud reporting module
Sensor latency: ~2.5 seconds from detection to mobile alert.



Metric
Result




Zones covered
4


Gas sensors deployed
60+


Wearable tags
30


Daily active users
120+


Response time improvement
↓ 62%


Deployment time
~4 weeks



Edge-side filtering reduces false alarms & saves bandwidth

BLE + MQTT stack** enables lightweight, multi-zone design

Custom hardware = better sensor layout fit & environmental tolerance

Mobile UX increases on-site adoption and supervisor engagement

articles.description:
go-pubsub - A Lightweight Pub-Sub Library for Golang


Hey everyone, I've been working on a Golang library called go-pubsub. It's a lightweight publish-subscribe tool designed for scenarios where you need to handle transient data flows efficiently. Think live dashboards, game events, short-lived alerts, or real-time streaming-media packet fan-out. The library is built with a fire-and-forget approach: no persistence, no delivery guarantees—just ultra-fast, one-way messaging.
I created go-pubsub while working on a Golang-based streaming media protocol conversion gateway. One of the core features of this gateway was real-time media stream fan-out, where a single input stream needed to be distributed to multiple output streams. This required an efficient Pub-Sub mechanism.
Initially, I used Re…

Intellectual property rights are the legal protections granted to creators, innovators, and businesses over their creative works, inventions, and brands. These safeguards ensure you maintain control, recognition, and financial benefit from your ideas and creations.
Copyright protects original creative works—such as books, music, software, films, and art—as soon as they're fixed in a tangible form. It grants exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, adapt, perform, or display your work, usually for the author’s lifetime plus 50–70 years, depending on jurisdiction.
